deviations.baseline_behavior: Windows runtimes ship `Get-Counter`, `Get-WinEvent`, `New-WinEvent` in the default command set (assembly Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.Diagnostics).
deviations.proposed_behavior: Do not ship OS-specific diagnostics cmdlets in the default set; offer them as optional modules.
deviations.benefit: Smaller default attack surface and a portable base command set.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Scripts calling these cmdlets need the optional module installed.

deviations.baseline_behavior: WSMan client cmdlets and provider (assembly Microsoft.WSMan.Management) are part of the Windows command set.
deviations.proposed_behavior: Omit WSMan commands; remoting transport becomes pluggable behind one session abstraction.
deviations.benefit: No dependency on a Windows-only protocol stack in the base product.
deviations.compatibility_cost: WSMan-based automation breaks; an optional transport module could restore it.

deviations.proposed_behavior: Provide CIM/WMI access only as an optional adapter module.
deviations.benefit: Keeps the base command set free of Windows management stacks.
deviations.compatibility_cost: Windows management scripts need the optional module.
